title: Evening Thanksgiving Prayer
text:
O God, our life, our strength, our food,
our rest, our peace, our all:
I thank you for the gifts of this day.
Forgive me the sins I have committed,
and the virtue I have failed to practice.
Bless those I love,
have mercy on those who have wronged me,
and make me faithful to you unto death.
Grant me and all for whom I pray
a peaceful night and a holy death.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit,
as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be,
world without end.
Amen.

translation.latin:
Deus, vita nostra, fortitudo nostra, cibus noster,
requies nostra, pax nostra, omnia nostra:
tibi gratias ago pro donis huius diei.
Ignosce mihi peccata quae commisi,
et virtutem quam exercere neglegi.
Benedic quos diligo,
miserere eorum qui mihi nocuerunt,
et fac me tibi fidelem usque ad mortem.
Concede mihi et omnibus pro quibus oro
noctem placidam et mortem sanctam.
Gloria Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto,
sicut erat in principio, et nunc, et semper,
et in saecula saeculorum.
Amen.

notes: This formal evening prayer combines thanksgiving for the day's blessings, petition for forgiveness, intercession for others, and a request for God's protection through the night. It concludes with the Gloria Patri, making it a complete evening devotion.
